AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  October 17, 2017
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present: Thomas, Chang, Lazzaro, Criley & Walker
Absent: None
Also Present: Deputy City Manager/Building & Planning Director Repp-Loadsman, City
Planner Corpuz, Assistant City Attorney Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Janine Nendick discussed Planning Commission review of the floor area ratio and gross floor
area and questioned if the tools have changed by the Commission on how they review
projects.

  Redondo Beach, CA 90277

Actions: Commissioner Walker moved and Chair Thomas seconded to approve the
application (5-0 in favor).

Planning Commission  1  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
October 17, 2017
 OLD BUSINESS

2.  NC-1601/G-1603/M-1212/M-1213-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility,
  Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 701
  Mexico Place. Lot 3, Block 1430, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Tomaro Architecture
  2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd., #100
  Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner:  Joseph & Annakutty Thomas

Speakers: Louie Tomaro, Steven Underberger, Cynthia Underberger, Sal Danna, Judith Sipes,
David Constable, Steve Dinsmore, Janine Nendick, Stan Abraham
Actions: Commissioner Chang moved and Commissioner Walker seconded to continue the
Miscellaneous Application Nos. M-1212-17 and M-1213-17 and to approve the Neigborhood
Compatibility and Grading applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the
following additional conditions: 1) The existing asphalt concrete curb along the frontage of
701 Mexico Place (Lot 3) and the lot the south of 701 Mexico Place (Lot 4) shall be removed
and concrete curb and gutter constructed. The curb and gutter shall be extended to join
existing curb and gutter at the rear property line of 1617 Via Arriba. Separate street plans,
including plan and profile, shall be prepared by a registered civil engineer and submitted for
review and approval by the City Engineer; 2) The project creates, adds or replaces more than
10,000 square feet of impervious surface on Lot 3. Thus, it shall comply with the City’s
municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C;
3) Portions of the existing wall and pilasters that lie along the southerly property line of Lot 4
encroach into City Parklands shall be removed as non-standard encroachments in Parklands;
4) The existing chainlink fencing at the rear of the property behind Lots 3 and 4 within the
right-of-way along Palos Verdes Drive West shall be removed; 5) A reciprocal ingress/egress
easement to the public road right-of-way across Lot 4 benefitting Lot 3 shall be prepared and
submitted for review and approval by the City Engineer. The final approved easement
document shall be recorded at the County Recorder’s Office prior to issuance of Certificate of
Occupancy; 6) Should the Palos Verdes Homes Association and/or Art Jury not approve the
shared driveway design, as shown on the site plan, the project shall be redesigned to have two
separate driveways for Lots 3 and 4; 7) A lot line adjustment is proposed to move the property
line between Lots 3 and 4. A Certificate of Compliance Lot Line Adjustment application shall
be submitted to the City and processed in accordance with Chapter 16.24 of the City’s
Municipal Code. The final approved Certificate of Compliance Lot Line Adjustment shall be
recorded at the County Recorder’s Office prior to issuance of Certificate of Occupancy; 8)
The plans call out a tree within the Palos Verdes Drive West right-of-way at the rear of the
property to be removed. Parklands Committee or City approval shall be obtained for the
removal of the tree; 9) Landscape vegetation shall be limited to the ridge height of the
adjacent building; and 10) The master bedroom patio cover shall be eliminated.

3.  NC-1603-17; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions &
  remodeling to the single family residence located at 2825 Via Neve. Lot 16, Block 2235,

 5.  NC-1604/G-1604/M-1219-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 3701 Via
  Valmonte. Lot 23, Block 6216, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Fabio Rigo De Righi
  10956 Weyburn Ave. #210
  Los Angeles, CA 90024
  Owner:  Harjot Gill & Uday Reddy
  26739 Shadow Wood Dr.
  Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275

Speakers: Fabio Rigo De Righi, Kathy Huben, Samantha Lamberg, Allan Rigg, Harjot Gill
Actions: Commissioner Chang moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the
applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
1) A licensed survey of the floor area shall be completed and submitted to the City to verify
compliance with the approved floor area for the subject lot; 2) The existing damaged
driveway shall be removed and replaced in accordance with City standards; 3) The ridge
height for the one-story west wing shall be lowered by 1 ft.; 4) The ridge height for the portion
of the building parallel to Via Valmonte shall be lowered by 1 ft.

NEW BUSINESS

6.  CDP-107/M-1221-17; Consideration of Coastal Development Permit & Miscellaneous
  Applications for a new wrought iron fence and landscaping within the setback adjacent to
  the street at the single family residence located at 2801 Via Segovia. Lot 1, Tract 23062.
  This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Rainville Design Studio
  1632 Aviation Blvd.
  Redondo Beach, CA 90278
  Owner:  Jeffrey & Roberta Coppersmith

Speakers: Allan Rigg, Jeff Coppersmith, Jeff Lewis, Scott Kidman, Sue Kidman, Miriam
Rainville, John Eberhard, Roberta Coppersmith
Actions: Chair Thomas moved and Commissioner Chang seconded to deny the Miscellaneous
Application and approve the Coastal Development Permit (5-0 in favor) with standard
conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Any hedge adjacent to the proposed
fencing shall not exceed 6.5 ft.; 2) The fence shall extend along the bluff to fully enclose the
property; and 3) A 6.5 ft. high fence shall be allowed along the 20 ft. setback line along Paseo
Del Mar.

Planning Commission  4  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
October 17, 2017
 7.  NC-1606/G-1607-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading
  Applications for additions and remodeling to the single family residence located at 2537 Via
  Anita. Lot 24, Block 1701, Tract 6882. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Ras-A, Inc.
  2507 W. 190th St.
  Redondo Beach, CA 90278
  Owner:  Stefan & Christiane Rohrberg

Speakers: Stefan Rohrberg, Paul Miller, Robert Sweet
Actions: Commissioner Walker moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the
applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
1) Valmonte PV Stone Curb (PVE Std Plan ST-19) shall be constructed along the property
frontage; 2) A new driveway approach shall be constructed at the discretion of the City
Engineer; and 3) The stepping stones/pavers behind the curb within the City right-of-way
shall be removed.

8.  NC-1608/G-1606/M-1225-17; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 700 Via Zumaya.
  Lot 1, Block 2318, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Douglas J. Leach, Architect
  119 W. Torrance Blvd. # 24
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Jonah & Jamie Schnel

Speakers: Joseph Fournier, Jamie Schnel, Jonah Schnel, Frances Tsai, Jason Whitehead
Actions: Chair Thomas moved and Commissioner Criley seconded to approve the
applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
1) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the public right-of-way and alley,
which include, but are not limited to a shed, block wall, paving, and brick sidewalk; 2) New
curb, curb and gutter and/or Hollywood Berm shall be constructed per City standards along
the Via Zumaya and Via Pacheco frontages per the City Engineer; 3) A new driveway
approach shall be constructed per City standards with removal of the existing driveway; and
4) The second story master bedroom deck shall be limited to 160 sq. ft.

Planning Commission  5  Director  SR-L
Action Minutes
October 17, 2017
 9.  NC-1610-17; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a deck
  extension at the single family residence located at 1705 Via Boronada. Lot 16, Block 1372,

  Applicant/Owner:  John & Feng Readyhoff

10.  Proposed Ordinance Amendment banning commercial marijuana activities, regulating
  indoor cultivation of marijuana for personal use, and prohibiting outdoor cultivation of
  marijuana for personal use within the City; and amending Section 8.56.020 (smoking
  prohibited) to include additional locations where smoking is prohibited in light of current
  state laws regarding recreational marijuana use.

Actions: Commissioner Walker moved and Chair Thomas seconded to adopt Resolution No.
PCR-2017-1036 (4-1 in favor, Criley dissenting) recommending approval of the proposed
ordinance to the City Council.

11.  Minor Modifications - Received & filed.

12.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule - Received & filed.

13.  Meeting of September 19, 2017.

Action: Commissioner Criley moved and Commissioner Chang seconded to approve (4-0 in
favor, Thomas abstained) the minutes as written.

Adjourned at 12:12 am
